scope: Guidelines for granting and operating BIS licenses for Electric Immersion Water Heaters according to IS 302-2-201:2008.
sampling_guidelines: Samples drawn across wattage ratings (e.g. 1000W, 1500W, 2000W) for full type testing and factory quality inspection.

routine_tests: High-voltage flash electric strength (1500V AC, 1 sec)
Power consumption / wattage check at rated voltage (230V)
type_tests: Full clause 7 to clause 32 qualification testing
Abnormal operation dry-boil safety cutout test
Mechanical drop and impact test (0.5 J)

raw_material_controls: Plugs must conform to IS 1293 (ISI marked)
Flexible supply cord must conform to IS 694 (ISI marked)
Heating tube sheath: Corrosion resistant nickel-plated copper or austenitic stainless steel
